title: The Ironbound Preceptor Aldous confession scene at Cinderhall gates several escalation options ('make the truth public' / 'corner him' / 'denounce him publicly') behind further Ironbound-reputation loss even though the truth had already been extracted peacefully moments before via a Warden-only dialogue option; there is no lower-cost way to simply close the matter without either taking a further reputation hit or leaving the escalation options sitting unused in the menu indefinitely.
where: Iron Downs / The Ironbound Chapterhouse (talk to Preceptor Aldous)
